name: db-connectivity-pathtrace
description: Given a database endpoint (Aurora, RDS, DocumentDB, or DynamoDB via VPC endpoint) and a failing client, traces the complete network path and finds the break point - security group egress and inbound, NACLs, route tables, VPC endpoints or PrivateLink for DynamoDB, DNS resolution of the endpoint, TLS certificate validation, and cross-VPC or cross-account reachability - using VPC Reachability Analyzer and Flow Log REJECT records. Read-only and cross-engine. Native AWS reads need no MCP; optionally recommends a custom DB-endpoint MCP.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 09:00 UTC
